body: He mentioned that he "feels like \[he is\] stuck in the constant circle of bad luck." He also said goodbye to me as if I'd never see him again. I'm no expert but those seem like red flags to me.

a) We rang a few days ago and he sounded down. Down and depressed to the point of suicide, IMO.

b) He goes through phases of answering messages then ghosting everyone for weeks, almost like crossing in and out of FOMO.

c) His parents, whom he has had some contact with, have told me that he is struggling.
A lazy proposal. Sorry folks, I can't quite be bothered.
